feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured
entry.summary: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.

entry.title: UN peacekeepers give NPR a rare look behind Israeli lines
entry.summary: NPR accompanies UN peacekeepers behind Israeli lines as Israel expands its occupation of South Lebanon following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire.

entry.title: 'I'll never trust them again': Some Afghans who helped the U.S. post-9/11 regret it
entry.summary: Soon after the Sept. 11 attacks, the U.S. launched what would become a 20-year war in Afghanistan. Some Afghans who helped the U.S. prosecute that war regret it.

entry.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
entry.summary: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

entry.title: U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns
entry.summary: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.

entry.title: Citing the 'Deep State,' Trump overhauls the intelligence community
entry.summary: The catastrophic 9/11 attacks forced the intelligence community to radically revamp its ways of doing business. Now, critics say, President Trump is dismantling much of what was built since then.

entry.title: Iceland summons U.S. ambassador after Trump posts countries draped with American flag
entry.summary: Iceland summoned the U.S. ambassador after President Trump posted a map on Truth Social that showed the country, along with a number of other nations, covered with an American flag.

entry.title: U.S. military says it destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers after attacks on Navy warship
entry.summary: The U.S. military said it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in response to the latest attacks on its warships. Iran hit American targets in Jordan.

entry.title: Kenya's foreign trader crackdown sparks fear among migrant communities
entry.summary: Kenya's president orders a crackdown on foreigners running small businesses, amid accusations of xenophobia.

entry.title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
entry.summary: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.
